blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mynt Inc., the parent company of the group behind GCash, opened its approximately P53-billion initial public offering (IPO), with subscriptions available through the GCash app starting at P660. On Tuesday, Mynt said on Tuesday that the offer runs from Oct. 6 to 12 at P6.60 per share. Through GStocks PH, offered by AB Capital Securities Inc., investors can order a minimum of 100 shares.
